recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered portrait of a male figure with reddish-brown hair, wearing large black square sunglasses and a highly decorative face mask covered in multi-colored rhinestones and 3D lettering. The background is a smooth, soft gradient transitioning from teal-blue at the top to a muted pink-purple at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The high-contrast black sunglasses anchor the upper half of the face against the vibrant mask.
The 3D texture of the mask contrasts with the smooth, airbrushed quality of the skin and background.
The wide-tracked typography at the bottom provides a stable, horizontal base for the vertical composition.
coreInvariants: Wide letter spacing for footer text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying approximately 80% of the vertical frame from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, reflective lenses of the sunglasses serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the dark sunglasses, move down to the textured mask, and finally settle on the wide-spaced text at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced negative space on the left and right sides of the head, emphasizing the silhouette.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black in the sunglasses, hair shadows, and jacket lapels.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multi-colored spectrum (red, yellow, green, blue) within the mask's rhinestones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the mask elements against a desaturated, soft-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid harsh primary colors in the background

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the bottom of the subject's torso

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme tracking to create a modern, cinematic feel.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment bar effect created by text width

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and clarity.
Open-source alternative with similar geometric properties.
Classic geometric choice for a high-fashion look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with reddish hair, wearing large black square sunglasses and a face mask covered in colorful sparkling rhinestones. The background should be a soft teal-to-pink vertical gradient. The lighting should be bright and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase geometric sans-serif text in white at the very bottom. Apply extreme tracking so the text spans nearly the full width of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking wide enough to span the chest width?
Is the mask texture visibly crystalline/rhinestone-like?
Is the background gradient smooth without banding?
Are the sunglasses solid black and reflective?

adjustableVariables: Rhinestone color pattern on the mask
Tracking width of the footer text
mustRedesign: Specific names or words on the mask
Exact facial likeness of the celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the mask does not look like a flat print but has physical depth.
Verify the gradient transition is seamless.
Confirm the sunglasses have a high-gloss finish.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered portrait + textured accessory + soft gradient background + wide-tracked footer text.
